env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key — used to call the images/edits endpoint.

env.name: OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL
env.description: Which OpenAI image model to call (e.g. gpt-image-1, or a newer one your account has access to). Defaults to gpt-image-1 if unset.

env.name: AD_IMAGE_OUTPUT_DIR
env.description: Where generated images are written on disk. Defaults to ./generated/ad-images if unset.
